description: Tracks product-building and design tool repositories from GitHub signals.

items.description: 🚀 A self-hostable personal dashboard built for you. Includes status-checking, widgets, themes, icon packs, a UI editor and tons more!
The world's best AI personal assistant for email. Open source app to help you reach inbox zero fast.
Ever® Gauzy™ - Open Business Management Platform (ERP/CRM/HRM/ATS/PM) - https://gauzy.co

NEO Emacs (WIP): GPU powered Emacs written in Rust with a modern display engine. Aiming for modern design & multi-threaded Elisp, 10x performance, zero-pause concurrent GC and 100% Emacs compatibility.
Tabee: rename, re-icon, pin, group and mute Chrome tabs automatically with URL rules. Free and open source.
Kition brings Markdown, DataTable, WhiteBoard, a tool-using AI agent, browser research, and visual workflows into one desktop workspace.

All your computers and your phone, working as one desk. Screens, apps, files, clipboard, calls, texts, notifications, mouse and keyboard, shared between Mac, Windows, Linux and Android. Free and open source. No account, no cloud, and now no shared network needed.
Fast, free voice assistant for your Mac. No API key: runs on your Claude Pro or Max plan. Sends background agents for big jobs, remembers you and learns your shortcuts. Hold ⌃⌥Space and talk.
regex101 for the terminal — real-time matching, 3 engines, capture groups, replace mode, syntax highlighting, plain-English explanations, undo/redo, mouse support. Written in Rust.
Tiling that feels like it shipped with macOS. Works out of the Box, settings menu, in-app updates, native Desktops kept intact, Lua underneath. Accessibility only, never SIP.

Free, sub-second on-device AI dictation for macOS. Dual engines (Whisper + Parakeet) on Apple Silicon. Optional AI polish on your Mac with EG-1 or S1-mini by Superwhisper, Apple Intelligence (macOS 26), Ollama, or your own OpenAI/Gemini/Claude key. Snippets, custom words, no account, no subscription, audio never leaves your Mac.

Your work, already underway. A personal AI assistant for your job: mail, chats and tickets become tasks, the agents you already use (Claude Code, Codex, Gemini) do the work, and nothing goes out until you approve. Open source, runs on your machine.
Your tasks, your server. An open-source, local-first task manager you can host yourself. Everything you expect from a commercial task app, without the subscription or the lock-in.

Oyenza Studio (formerly Oyen Poni): a living notch (Dynamic Island) for Windows and Mac. Music with synced lyrics, a focus timer, a file shelf your phone can drop into, tasks, clipboard history and live system stats. Native Rust, free and open source.
